Actionloop.name: Magnetica
Actionloop.summary:
Magnetica is a puzzle game for Nintendo DS in which players use the stylus to launch marbles onto a moving track. The aim is to match three or more marbles of the same colour before the line reaches the end of the path.

The game features single-player modes, including Challenge, Quest, and Puzzle, with different tracks, power-ups, hazards, and stage layouts. It also includes head-to-head multiplayer, where players can use items that obstruct, deflect or alter the movement of launched marbles.

ALC no 10-punkan Eigo Master - Chuukyuu.name: ALC no 10-Punkan Eigo Master: Chuukyuu
ALC no 10-punkan Eigo Master - Chuukyuu.summary: An edutainment game for the Nintendo DS.

Are You Smarter than a 5th Grader - Make.name: Are You Smarter Than A 5th Grader?: Make the Grade
Are You Smarter than a 5th Grader - Make.summary: Based on the TV game show. Quiz yourself!

Dragon Ball Z - Goku Densetsu.name: Dragon Ball Z: Harukanaru Densetsu
Dragon Ball Z - Goku Densetsu.summary: Dragon Ball Z: Harukanaru Densetsu is a card based role-playing video game for the Nintendo DS. The game takes place from the beginning of the Saiyan Saga to the end of the Cell Saga. Players choose from one of the four main character, Goku, Gohan, Piccolo, and Vegeta. Other characters also appear, but only as either enemies or support cards.

Fullmetal Alchemist - Dual Sympathy.name: Fullmetal Alchemist: Dual Sympathy
Fullmetal Alchemist - Dual Sympathy.summary:
Hagane no Renkinjutsushi: Dual Sympathy (Fullmetal Alchemist: Dual Sympathy as it is known in English) is the first in a series of Fullmetal Alchemist games to be released on Nintendo DS.

A side scrolling action game, Dual Sympathy has the player manipulate alchemy skills using the stylus as you fight enemies, making use of standard attacks and special attacks based on the surrounding environment and items items located in the area.

The story of the game follows the fifty one episode anime series with the same name.

Connectivity bonuses can be unlocked by having the GBA Fullmetal Alchemist games in the GBA slot of the DS.

Littlest Pet Shop 3 - Biggest Stars - Pi.name: Littlest Pet Shop 3: Biggest Stars - Pink Team
Littlest Pet Shop 3 - Biggest Stars - Pi.summary: Get ready to go for the gold! It's time to hit the arena for the LITTLEST PET SHOP Biggest Stars competition—and this time your pets are in the spotlight! Ten fun and challenging mini games are your pets' tickets to the big time. Practice makes perfect as you help your pets become the best gymnasts, models, ice skaters, dancers, flyers, fashion designers, and more. Then pack up their cute team uniforms and the dozens of super-fun accessories you've customized because it's time to hit the road! The Biggest Stars competition is the event of year, when the pet-triplet judges look for teams that are a triple threat; cute, peppy and totally talented! Good thing that with your help, all your LITTLEST PET SHOP pet's Biggest Stars dreams really can come true!

Mystery Case Files - Prime Suspects.name: Mystery Case Files: Prime Suspects
Mystery Case Files - Prime Suspects.summary: The Queen's Hope Diamond has been stolen! It's up to you to search for clues, find the offending culprit, and recover the stolen gem!

Seitokai no Ichizon - DS Suru Seitokai.name: Seitokai no Ichizon: DS Suru Seitokai
Seitokai no Ichizon - DS Suru Seitokai.summary: You take control of Sugisaki Ken, the sole male member of Hekiyou Academy's student council. Your mission is to make the rest of the student council members his harem by Christmas Day by improving popularity for nine months from April to December.
